en.t: On the whole, the tone was gentle.

units.source_text: 但字里行间，显然含有言外之意。

en.t: Yet between the lines there was clearly an unspoken meaning.

units.source_text: 源氏公子读了这信，深为感动，一时不忍释手。

en.t: Prince Genji read the letter and was deeply moved, unable for a while to put it down.

units.source_text: 为欲对紫姬表示忠诚，此后许久不与明石姬幽会。

en.t: Wanting to show his loyalty to Lady Murasaki, he did not meet privately with the lady of Akashi for a long time afterward.
